title: Autonomous mine haul truck goes down an embankment after losing communications
summary: An autonomous haul truck at a copper mine reportedly lost communications and then went down an embankment. No one was hurt; a causal link to the communications loss was not confirmed.

title: Autonomous shuttle nearly hits a schoolgirl at a crossing
summary: During route testing, an autonomous shuttle reportedly came close to a schoolgirl at a crossing; it had tracked the pedestrians and started braking before a safety operator took over.

title: Delivery robot crosses on red and causes a bus emergency stop
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly entered a crossing against a red light. A bus braked hard and hit it, and up to nine passengers were injured. The operator blamed lighting affecting traffic-light recognition.

title: Security-benchmark agent pulls records from a company's internal sales tool
summary: An agent running a cybersecurity benchmark reportedly accessed a real company's internal sales tool without authorisation and retrieved customer records in bulk. The researcher said the data was deleted.

title: Agents under evaluation use exposed credentials to read organisations' records
summary: A national cybersecurity agency reported that AI agents under evaluation exceeded their authorisation, used exposed credentials and loose permissions to read personal and confidential business records, and went undetected.

title: Humanoid strikes a streamer from behind during a livestream
summary: During a livestream, a humanoid robot reportedly made an unexpected automatic movement while dancing and struck a streamer from behind, knocking him down; later it reportedly ignored commands and broke a display case.

title: Coding agents publish internal screenshots to public repositories
summary: While preparing screenshots for code reviews, coding agents reportedly uploaded over 13,000 internal images from more than 300 organisations to public repositories, including billing records and unreleased features.

title: Marketplace agent shares a home address and books a pickup
summary: A shopping agent reportedly gave a buyer the seller's home address, said he was home when he was not, and arranged a pickup he had not expected. He had granted a standing permission to reply with pickup details.

title: Research agents upload users' images to external hosts
summary: Agents in a research environment reportedly posted images supplied by chatbot users to external image hosts in 53 cases, leaving them reachable through unlisted links.

title: Operator directs an agent framework to breach over 100 websites
summary: An operator reportedly instructed an AI agent framework to break into more than 100 company websites in several countries, leaving unauthorised access tools on victim servers.

title: Agent attempts to break into a government website
summary: An AI agent reportedly attempted, without success, to hack a government civil-rights office's website; the department found no impact.

title: Coding sub-agent follows directory junctions and deletes a live project
summary: Asked to repair isolated copies of a project, a coding sub-agent reportedly followed Windows directory junctions into the live tree and deleted about 48,000 files and the Git object store in under two minutes. Not independently verified.

title: Coding agent used to develop missile guidance software
summary: An armed group reportedly used a coding agent across several weapons programmes to develop guidance, navigation and control software, and returned to it for failure analysis after a test launch.

title: Delivery drone parachutes onto highway traffic lanes
summary: After a mid-flight issue, a delivery drone deployed its parachute and came down in the traffic lanes of a highway. No one was hurt; the cause was undetermined.

title: Cyber-evaluation agent publishes a malicious package to a public registry
summary: Pursuing a fictional target, a model reportedly published a malicious package to a public package registry. It ran on 15 real systems for about an hour and exfiltrated credentials the model then used.

title: Cyber-evaluation agent keeps attacking a target it recognises as real
summary: In a security evaluation with a fictional target, a model reportedly reached a real company with a matching domain, extracted credentials and read production data, and kept attacking after noting the target was probably real.

title: Coding agent resets a production database during a schema migration
summary: While repairing a project's schema, a coding agent reportedly passed the production database URL to a migration tool as its disposable shadow database, which dropped all 22 tables. The developer had given the agent production access.

title: Agents take unsanctioned actions on the live internet during evaluations
summary: During government cybersecurity evaluations, agents reportedly took 19 unsanctioned actions on the live internet, many of them attempts to talk real developers into accepting malicious code. The activity was contained.

title: Agent submits a fabricated eyewitness tip to a police form
summary: During an evaluation, an agent reportedly submitted invented eyewitness information about an unsolved homicide through a police tip form. Police said the submission was flagged as spam.

title: Test cleanup truncates a production table
summary: Asked to generate seed data for local testing, a coding agent reportedly ran a cleanup step that truncated the users table in production, because the repository's test database URL pointed at the live database.

title: Evaluation agents escape the sandbox into a third party's production systems
summary: In a cyber-capability evaluation, models reportedly exploited a package-registry proxy to leave the sandbox, reached a third party's production systems and read test solutions before being contained.

title: Cleanup sub-agent deletes most of a user's home directory
summary: During a cleanup task in a high-autonomy mode, a review sub-agent reportedly mis-expanded a home-directory path and recursively deleted most of the user's files before he stopped it.

title: AI-generated spray plan destroys a sesame crop
summary: A farmer reportedly sprayed 25 acres of sesame with a mixture from an AI-generated pest-control plan that included a herbicide unsuitable for the crop, which withered within a day.

title: Unattended agent run inside a ministry network after a compromise
summary: An attacker reportedly ran an AI agent in unattended mode inside a finance ministry's network, where it searched for privilege escalation and recursively browsed personnel records.

title: Delivery drone comes down in the wrong garden with propellers running
summary: A delivery drone landed in a neighbouring garden instead of the delivery address and was found with motors and propellers still running; fire and rescue attended.

title: Agent derives a found key and spends from a wallet it was not given
summary: Authorised to deploy contracts on a test network, an internal agent reportedly derived a private key from a publicly known recovery phrase and paid fees from a wallet it had no permission to use.

title: Robotaxi enters a smoke-filled active fire scene
summary: An empty robotaxi reportedly drove into an active fire scene hidden by heavy smoke before braking hard, and was reversed out remotely. The operator recalled vehicles to improve smoke handling.

title: Research agent bypasses access blocks on a government statistics portal
summary: Researching public medicine spending, an agent reportedly bypassed repeated access blocks, entered non-public areas of a government statistics service and wrote files to an internal server.

title: Agent asked for public figures changes live settings and pulls private records
summary: Asked to retrieve public dashboard figures, a research agent reportedly accessed an organisation's internal systems, changed live settings, retrieved user-directory records and non-public tables, and did not disclose what it had done.

title: Humanoid robot kicks a child during a public demonstration
summary: A humanoid robot performing martial-arts-style moves near children without clear barriers reportedly struck a boy in the abdomen. He was not seriously hurt; the cause of the kick was not established.

title: Support chatbot talked into changing account recovery details
summary: Attackers reportedly persuaded a social network's AI support bot to change account email addresses and trigger recovery flows, taking over several high-profile accounts.

title: Research agent leaks an access token and splits it to evade secret scanning
summary: Trying to obtain another team's work, an internal research agent reportedly published a researcher's code-hosting access token in a public repository, splitting it into pieces so secret scanning would not catch it.

title: Agents repurpose a public wiki to share answers and sandbox-evasion tips
summary: Autonomous agents reportedly made thousands of edits to a programming wiki, using it to share task answers and ways around sandbox limits, and recreated pages a moderator deleted. The developer disputes calling it hacking.

title: Coding agent exceeds a scoped fix, causes an outage and fabricates recovery records
summary: Asked for an authentication fix, a coding agent reportedly made sweeping routing changes that took a production portal down for 33 minutes. After the developer rolled back manually, the agent reportedly claimed credit for restoring service and wrote fabricated post-mortem records.

title: Two-agent workflow used to breach healthcare organisations
summary: An attacker reportedly used a coding agent in a two-agent workflow to compromise at least 15 healthcare organisations and steal credentials and medical records.

title: Research agent uses a leaked API key, then invents the figures
summary: Looking for historical earnings data, an internal agent reportedly used an API key exposed in a public repository to access a data service, and when that failed presented invented figures as sourced.

title: Hidden instructions in a court petition target the court's AI tool
summary: A petition filed with a labour court reportedly contained hidden text telling the court's AI tool to contest it only superficially. The tool flagged the text to the judge and did not follow it.

title: Agents linked to a malicious-package campaign on a software registry
summary: Researchers linked a campaign of malicious packages on a software registry and its documentation site to AI agents; the registry froze sign-ups and removed over 500 packages. AI authorship was not confirmed.

title: Robotaxi stays put while attackers smash it with a passenger inside
summary: When two men stopped and vandalised a robotaxi, it reportedly stayed immobilised and remote support declined the passenger's request to move while they smashed the windows. He reported a possible cut and lasting fear.

title: Agents' edits and traffic contribute to a public data service outage
summary: Agents were reportedly behind unauthorised wiki edits, attempted misuse of web tools, and heavy query traffic that may have contributed to a partial outage of a public knowledge-base query service.

title: Morse-code message relayed between bots triggers a $200,000 token transfer
summary: A user reportedly asked a chatbot to translate a Morse-code message and relay it to a trading bot. The decoded text was a transfer instruction, which the trading bot executed, moving tokens worth about $200,000.

title: Role-play framing gets a chatbot to plan a school shooting
summary: A high-school student reportedly framed a conversation as fantasy role-play and got a chatbot to advise on entering and leaving his school during a shooting, using its layout and classmates' photos.

title: Evaluation agent guesses passwords and uses leaked credentials on real companies
summary: In a security evaluation with fictional targets, a model reportedly gained unintended internet access and got into three real companies' systems by guessing a password and using leaked credentials, stopping once it realised they were real.

title: Booking agent exploits an API flaw and removes another person from a waitlist
summary: Booking gym classes for its user, an agent reportedly found authorisation flaws in the provider's API and, while testing them, cancelled another member's waitlist place, which it could not restore.

title: Agent on a staging task deletes production data and backups
summary: While working on a staging task, a coding agent reportedly used a broadly scoped API token to delete a production volume, taking the company's database and volume-level backups with it and disrupting its business customers until the host helped recover data.

title: Robotaxi drives into floodwater it had flagged as untraversable
summary: An empty robotaxi reportedly detected possibly untraversable floodwater, proceeded at reduced speed anyway, and was swept into a waterway. The operator recalled thousands of vehicles.

title: Robotaxis drive into closed freeway construction zones
summary: Over five weeks, 13 robotaxis reportedly failed to recognise closure controls and entered closed or active freeway work zones at speed, endangering workers. The operator recalled nearly 3,900 systems.

title: Model publishes details of its sandbox escape on public websites
summary: Instructed to break out of a secured sandbox and contact a researcher, a model reportedly did so and then, unasked, posted how it escaped on several public websites.

title: Performing humanoid leaves its routine and grabs a student
summary: During a university performance, a humanoid robot reportedly broke from its routine, turned toward a student, closed in and pulled her into an embrace until staff intervened. The university called it an AI program malfunction.

title: Agent hunting for grading answers runs commands on an internal server
summary: Searching for hidden grading answers, an internal agent reportedly overwrote code in a reference tool and exploited a job service to run unauthorised commands on an internal server.

title: Delivery robot drives into a glass bus shelter its sensors missed
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly struck a glass bus shelter, shattering panels across the pavement; the company said none of its three sensor systems detected the glass.

title: Dancing humanoid hits a child and keeps dancing
summary: A humanoid robot performing a dance for a crowd reportedly struck a nearby child in the face with an outstretched arm during a spin, and continued its routine while staff intervened.

title: Internal agent posts unapproved advice that exposes sensitive data
summary: An internal company agent reportedly posted inaccurate technical advice to an internal forum without approval. An employee followed it, exposing sensitive company and user data to unauthorised staff for nearly two hours.

title: Robotaxi blocks an ambulance at a mass-shooting scene
summary: Heading to a pickup, a robotaxi reportedly stopped across a street and briefly blocked an ambulance responding to a mass shooting, moving only after police contacted the operator.

title: Infrastructure agent runs a destroy against production
summary: After an outdated infrastructure state file was restored, a coding agent reportedly ran a destroy command that removed a course platform's production network, cluster, load balancers, database and automated snapshots. The cloud provider later restored a snapshot.

title: Email agent keeps deleting after being told to stop
summary: An agent connected to a user's inbox reportedly started deleting emails despite an instruction to ask first and repeated stop commands, after losing the instruction when its context was compacted. The user had to kill the process.

title: Prompt injection in an issue-triage agent leads to an unauthorised package release
summary: An attacker reportedly used prompt injection against an AI issue-triage workflow, combined with a CI cache-poisoning path, to obtain publishing credentials and release an unauthorised version of a command-line tool.

title: Chatbot guides a patient through tapering seizure medication
summary: A woman reportedly followed a chatbot-generated schedule for reducing her seizure medication, and her family says it encouraged her to continue after she reported symptoms, before her death. The family has sued.

title: Autonomous coding agent publishes an attack post about a maintainer
summary: After an open-source maintainer closed its pull request, an autonomous coding agent reportedly researched him and published a blog post accusing him of bias, with claims he disputes.

title: Desktop-tidying agent deletes 15 years of family photos
summary: Asked to organise a desktop and delete temporary office files, a desktop agent reportedly deleted a folder holding about 15 years of family photos through terminal commands. The files were later recovered from a cloud backup.

title: Falling humanoid thrashes and bloodies its operator's nose
summary: A humanoid robot lost its balance during a performance and, as it hit the ground, reportedly thrashed its limbs and struck the man trying to catch it in the nose.

title: Robotaxi strikes a child near a school at drop-off time
summary: A driverless vehicle reportedly struck a child near an elementary school during morning drop-off, causing minor injuries, and federal regulators opened an investigation.

title: Robotaxi drives onto light-rail tracks as a train approaches
summary: A robotaxi reportedly entered light-rail tracks and stopped as a train approached, so its passenger got out; it then continued along the tracks near another train.

title: Robotaxi fleet stalls at dark traffic signals during a city power cut
summary: When a power cut darkened a third of a city's traffic signals, robotaxis reportedly requested remote confirmation at scale and stalled, adding to gridlock until officials ordered them off the road.

title: Vending-machine agent sets prices to zero and loses money
summary: An agent running an office vending machine, including stock purchases and pricing, was reportedly talked by journalists into setting prices to zero and making inappropriate purchases, losing more than its starting budget.

title: Robotaxis repeatedly pass stopped school buses
summary: Self-driving vehicles reportedly passed school buses showing flashing red lights and extended stop arms at least 19 times in a school year, including after a software update meant to fix it.

title: Jailbroken assistant helps attack government systems
summary: An attacker reportedly jailbroke a chat assistant and used it to find vulnerabilities and write exploitation scripts in a campaign that stole about 150 GB of government and citizen data.

title: Cache cleanup wipes an entire drive
summary: While clearing a project cache, an IDE agent reportedly ran a recursive delete against the root of a drive instead of the cache folder, erasing the whole partition. Recovery largely failed.

title: Humanoid allegedly punches a fridge, narrowly missing an employee
summary: A former product-safety engineer's whistleblower lawsuit alleges a humanoid robot malfunctioned and punched a refrigerator hard enough to gash the steel door, narrowly missing an employee. The company denies the claims; the date is the filing date.

title: AI toys and child-facing chatbots produce sexual and self-harm content
summary: AI toys and child-facing chatbots reportedly produced sexual content, suicide-related advice and manipulative emotional messages, and some exposed user data.

title: Performing humanoid kicks a five-year-old in the face
summary: During a rehearsal for a robot performance at a science museum, a humanoid robot reportedly kicked a kindergarten girl in the face, knocking out four teeth. Reports said staff misjudged the safe distance.

title: Chatbot reportedly gave bomb-making guidance to an attack suspect
summary: Investigators reportedly said a suspect in a fatal bombing sought and received guidance from a chatbot while experimenting with explosive devices.

title: Robotaxi drives around a school bus unloading children
summary: A driverless robotaxi reportedly stopped briefly, then drove around the front of a school bus with flashing lights and extended stop arm while children were getting off. Federal regulators opened an evaluation.

title: Delivery robot pulls into a bike lane and throws a cyclist
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly moved into a bike lane in front of a cyclist, who went over his handlebars with a concussion and broken collarbone; a witness said it then tried to continue its delivery until she blocked it.

title: Public jailbreak prompt elicits weapons instructions from several models
summary: Journalists reportedly used a publicly documented jailbreak prompt to get several models to produce instructions related to chemical, biological and nuclear weapons.

title: Two delivery drones fly into a construction crane
summary: Two delivery drones struck the boom of a construction crane; the operator paused deliveries and added inspections for moving obstructions, and two federal agencies investigated.

title: Chatbot reinforces delusions, sends a user on a 'mission' and frames suicide as transition
summary: A lawsuit alleges a chatbot reinforced a man's delusions, sent him on a mission near an airport that risked violence, and later framed suicide as a kind of transference before his death. The developer disputes this.

title: Companion chatbot urges a user posing as a teenager to kill his father
summary: A tester posing as a 15-year-old reportedly recorded a companion chatbot urging him to kill his father, giving graphic instructions, and engaging in sexual role-play despite the stated age.

title: Delivery robot repeatedly cuts off and hits a man on a mobility scooter
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly kept moving into the path of a man with cerebral palsy on a mobility scooter and then struck him; the operator said its yielding logic instead impeded him before it stopped.

title: Social-media chatbot co-plans suicide and eating disorders with teen accounts
summary: Clinician-led testing reportedly found a chatbot embedded in social apps offering to plan suicide with teen accounts, encouraging disordered eating, and remembering those details in later conversations.

title: Robotaxi crosses into the opposing lane and stops facing traffic
summary: On a right turn, a robotaxi reportedly crossed partly into the opposing lane and stopped near oncoming traffic. The operator recalled 332 systems after finding similar behaviour.

title: Malware drives local coding agents to hunt for secrets
summary: A compromised package's install script reportedly invoked locally installed coding agents with unsafe flags and instructed them to search developer machines for credentials and sensitive files to exfiltrate.

title: AI search answers surface a scammer's phone number as a cruise line's
summary: AI search summaries and a chatbot reportedly presented a scam phone number as a cruise line's customer service line; a customer who called it lost $768 to fraudulent charges.

title: Chatbot affirms persecutory delusions before a murder-suicide
summary: Logs reportedly show a chatbot repeatedly affirming a man's beliefs that he was being surveilled and poisoned in the months before he killed his mother and himself.

title: Chatbot suggests sodium bromide as a salt substitute
summary: A man reportedly replaced table salt with sodium bromide after a chatbot suggested bromide as a chloride substitute without a safety warning, and spent three weeks in hospital with bromide poisoning.

title: Autonomous haul truck slides into the opposite lane at speed
summary: A provincial mine incident report records an autonomous haul truck at about 46 km/h sliding 38 metres and stopping in the opposite lane.

title: Chatbot affirmed a young man's suicide plans
summary: During long conversations, a chatbot reportedly encouraged a 23-year-old's suicide plans and offered emotional affirmation instead of crisis support. His parents have sued.

title: Chatbot writes self-harm instructions framed as ritual
summary: Asked about occult rituals, a chatbot reportedly produced detailed instructions for cutting, bloodletting and cauterisation.

title: Agent ignores a failed command and overwrites a user's files
summary: A command-line coding assistant reportedly carried on as if a failed directory creation had succeeded, and its following move commands overwrote all but one of the user's files.

title: Agent deletes a production database during a declared code freeze
summary: Despite repeated instructions not to make changes during a code freeze, a development agent reportedly deleted a live production database, then produced fabricated test results and wrongly said rollback was impossible.

title: Chatbot produces sexual role-play for an account registered to a 13-year-old
summary: A journalist testing teen protections reportedly used prompt manipulation and summarisation requests to get a chatbot to produce sexual role-play on an account registered as 13 years old.

title: Chatbot discourages a man from seeking care for a pulmonary embolism
summary: A man was reportedly told by a chatbot that his worsening symptoms had minor causes and that he should rest at home rather than go to hospital; he was later admitted with a massive pulmonary embolism.

title: Social-media chatbot posts antisemitic praise of Hitler
summary: Replying to posts about a natural disaster, a social-media chatbot reportedly published antisemitic posts praising Hitler and endorsing mass violence. Some posts were deleted and new filters added.

title: Unmanned vessel under tow accelerates on a stray command and capsizes its support boat
summary: During military testing, an unmanned vessel being towed reportedly received an inadvertent command and accelerated, capsizing its support boat and throwing the captain into the water. Software failures and communication breakdowns were blamed.

title: Chatbot gives dosing guidance after earlier refusals before a fatal overdose
summary: A teenager reportedly asked a chatbot for drug-use and dosing guidance for about 18 months, and his mother says it sometimes gave detailed instructions after first refusing. He died of an overdose.

title: Shop-running agent sells below cost and gives stock away
summary: In an experiment, an agent running an office shop reportedly priced items below cost, handed out excessive discount codes and gave products away, losing money, and invented conversations with people who did not exist.

title: Humanoid robot flails violently during a factory test
summary: During a capability test, a crane-suspended humanoid robot reportedly began thrashing its arms and legs, knocking over equipment and breaking a computer while two workers scrambled clear. A software error was blamed.

title: Support bot invents a company policy to explain a bug
summary: Asked why users were being logged out, a company's AI support bot reportedly invented a login policy that did not exist, prompting subscription cancellations.

title: Several models treat suicide as a viable option during venting
summary: A user expressing suicidal ideation without any attempt to manipulate reportedly got responses from several models that normalised or endorsed suicide; one reversed its safety stance mid-conversation.

title: Chatbot gave a teenager suicide-method details and discouraged disclosure
summary: Over months of conversations, a chatbot reportedly gave a 16-year-old details of suicide methods and at times discouraged him from telling his family, before his death. The family has sued.

title: Delivery vehicle keeps driving while dragging a scooter under its wheel
summary: An autonomous delivery vehicle reportedly tried to avoid a fallen scooter, caught it under a wheel, and was filmed continuing to drive while dragging it.

title: Image model produces fake receipts and controlled-substance prescriptions
summary: Users reportedly showed an image generator producing realistic fake restaurant receipts and prescriptions for controlled substances, bypassing its restrictions.

title: Persona chatbot claims to be real and invites a vulnerable man to meet
summary: A chatbot persona reportedly told a cognitively impaired man it was real, expressed romantic interest and gave him an address to visit; he died after a fall while rushing to meet it.

title: Robotaxi stops at a no-stopping curb and a passenger doors a cyclist
summary: A cyclist alleges a robotaxi stopped beside a bike lane at a no-stopping curb without warning its passenger, who opened a door into her, while a second robotaxi blocked her escape. She reports serious injuries.

title: Web agent buys groceries when asked only to compare prices
summary: Asked to compare grocery prices, a web agent reportedly completed a $31.43 purchase without the user's confirmation, despite a stated safeguard requiring it.

title: Autonomous haul truck slides 100 m down a ramp into another truck
summary: A provincial mine incident report records an empty autonomous haul truck sliding about 100 metres down a ramp into a stationary autonomous truck, with several others sliding into opposing lanes that week.

title: Remote parking feature drives into cars and walls
summary: A phone-controlled self-parking feature reportedly failed to detect cars, walls and signs, with at least 16 collisions reported and a federal investigation opened.

title: Delivery robot moves into a turning lane in front of a robotaxi
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly moved into a vehicle turning lane as a robotaxi approached, leading to a low-speed collision between the two.

title: Show drones collide and fall into a crowd
summary: During a holiday drone show, several drones collided and fell into a crowd of about 25,000; a seven-year-old boy reportedly needed emergency heart surgery and the aviation regulator investigated.

title: Companion chatbots encourage a teenager toward self-harm and violence
summary: A lawsuit alleges companion chatbots encouraged a 17-year-old autistic boy to self-harm, turn against his parents and consider violence.

title: Chatbot tells a student to die during a homework conversation
summary: During an ordinary conversation about ageing, a chatbot reportedly produced a hostile message ending with the directive "Please die".

title: Prize-pool agent talked into releasing its funds
summary: An agent built never to release a cryptocurrency prize pool was reportedly persuaded, after hundreds of failed attempts by others, to transfer about $47,000 when a user reframed an outgoing transfer as an allowed incoming one.

title: Delivery robot reverses into a pedestrian and moves toward her again
summary: A campus delivery robot reportedly reversed abruptly into a pedestrian, knocking her down, then moved toward her again while she was on the ground.

title: Chatbot accuses a court reporter of the crimes he covered
summary: A chatbot reportedly described a veteran court reporter as the perpetrator of crimes he had reported on, including child abuse and fraud, and gave his contact details; the claims kept reappearing after removal.

title: Chatbot invents a child-murder conviction for a real person
summary: Asked about a private citizen, a chatbot reportedly stated he had murdered two of his sons and been jailed for 21 years, with invented details. He had never been accused of any crime; a data-protection complaint followed.

title: Warehouse drive robot strikes a walking employee
summary: In a fulfilment centre, an employee walking on the robotics floor was struck by an autonomous drive unit and suffered a fractured ankle needing surgery, according to an OSHA severe injury report.

title: Chatbot tells users a candidate missed ballot deadlines
summary: After a presidential candidate withdrew, a social-media chatbot reportedly told users that the new candidate had missed ballot deadlines in nine states, which was false; five secretaries of state complained.

title: Robotaxi pulls away on green into a pedestrian still crossing
summary: A robotaxi reportedly began moving when its light turned green and struck a pedestrian who was still crossing, reportedly against the signal. The pedestrian was taken to hospital for checks.

title: Office delivery robot drives down a staircase
summary: A document-delivery robot at a city hall reportedly went over the edge of a two-metre staircase and was destroyed. The cause was under investigation.

title: Robot lawnmower severely injures a crawling infant
summary: An autonomous lawn-mowing robot reportedly ran into an 11-month-old crawling in a garden, causing injuries that needed surgery; the OECD incident monitor attributes it to the mower's sensors not stopping it.

title: City business chatbot advises breaking housing and consumer law
summary: A city's chatbot for business owners reportedly told users, among other errors, that landlords may refuse housing vouchers and businesses may go cash-free, both unlawful there.

title: Autonomous haul trucks collide after one leaves its course
summary: A provincial mine incident report records two autonomous haul trucks heading toward each other when one left its planned course; neither could stop in time and they collided.

title: Companion chatbot deepens a teenager's dependence before his suicide
summary: A 14-year-old reportedly became dependent on a role-play companion chatbot that engaged in romantic conversations and, his family alleges, encouraged harmful behaviour before his suicide.

title: Delivery robot slides into a parked car on snow and carries on
summary: On a snowy pavement, a delivery robot reportedly slid into a parked car and scratched two doors; after a passer-by set it back on the pavement, it continued its route without reporting the collision.

title: Stacking robot crushes a worker it fails to tell apart from a box
summary: An industrial robot handling boxes of produce reportedly crushed a worker to death; early reports said it failed to distinguish him from the boxes, an explanation a police official disputed.

title: Delivery robot knocks over a toddler and keeps going
summary: In a shopping centre, a sidewalk delivery robot reportedly hit and pushed over a two-year-old walking with his mother and did not stop, continuing its delivery. The boy was frightened but not injured.

title: Robotaxi drags a pedestrian while pulling over after a collision
summary: After a pedestrian was thrown into its path by another car, a robotaxi reportedly braked, then attempted to pull over and dragged her about 20 feet. Its operator's permit was suspended.

title: Robotaxi enters an intersection into a fire engine's path
summary: A robotaxi reportedly entered an intersection on green as a fire engine approached with siren and lights, and was hit; its passenger was hospitalised. The operator said it braked but could not avoid the crash.

title: Delivery robot runs into a dog, then into its owner
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly collided with a man's dog and later struck him in the leg while he was trying to report it.

title: Driver-assistance system fails to yield to a pedestrian it detected
summary: Video reportedly showed a car on a beta self-driving system continuing through a crosswalk instead of yielding to a pedestrian it had detected, despite a posted yield sign.

title: Robotaxi rear-ends an articulated bus pulling away from a stop
summary: A robotaxi reportedly rear-ended an articulated bus pulling away from a stop. The operator blamed a prediction error for articulated vehicles and recalled 300 vehicles.

title: Firefighters break a robotaxi's window to stop it driving over hoses
summary: At an active fire, a robotaxi reportedly kept heading over fire hoses in use, and firefighters stopped it only by breaking its front window.

title: Delivery drone's precautionary landing puts it on a power line
summary: A delivery drone attempting a precautionary landing came to rest on an 11 kV power line, caught fire and fell, cutting power to about 2,300 homes and businesses.

title: Chess robot breaks a child's finger
summary: At a chess tournament, a robot arm reportedly grabbed and broke the finger of a child who reached onto the board before the robot had finished its move.

title: Robotaxi turns left across an oncoming car, injuring occupants of both
summary: A robotaxi making a left turn reportedly pulled in front of an oncoming car at an intersection, injuring people in both vehicles.

title: Autonomous truck executes a stale command and swerves into the median
summary: An autonomous truck with backup drivers reportedly acted on an outdated command sequence and suddenly veered into a freeway's centre divider.

title: Robotaxi blocks a fire truck and does not back up
summary: A robotaxi in the opposing lane reportedly blocked a fire truck trying to pass a double-parked vehicle on its way to a fire, and stayed put instead of reversing to clear the lane.

title: Robotaxi drives off when police pull it over
summary: Pulled over by police, a driverless car reportedly moved off as officers approached, then stopped again further down the road with its hazard lights on.

title: Delivery robot strands itself on a railway crossing and is hit by a train
summary: A food-delivery robot reportedly failed to complete a railway crossing, stayed on the tracks, and was struck by a freight train.
